main.remarks: Activities manage the state of one command execution. The associated CommandDetails instance is mutable execution state and must not be reused for another execution.

field.name: freemode
field.summary: True if the command runs in free mode and owns completion and record.

field.name: commandlifecycle
field.summary: Atomic ownership marker for command-template lifecycle management.
field.remarks: Zero indicates an unclaimed Activity; one indicates that the base Command template owns task tracking, terminal record publication, and cleanup.

field.name: record
field.summary: Atomic write-once storage for the terminal Activity Record.

field.name: task
field.summary: Atomic write-once storage for the asynchronous completion task.

property.name: FreeMode
property.summary: True if the command runs in free mode (tool does not await completion or set the ActivityRecord).

property.name: Cancel
property.summary: Per-execution cancellation token source owned by this Activity.

property.name: Details
property.summary: Mutable command details associated with this single activity execution.

property.name: Record
property.summary: Gets the first terminal Activity Record published for this execution.

property.name: Task
property.summary: Gets or atomically assigns the asynchronous completion task; the first non-null assignment wins.
property.remarks: For inherited Command template execution, this is the tracked runner that applies the terminal result and performs cleanup. In free mode, callers can observe background completion through this task and .

method.name: CreateActivity
method.summary: Creates an Activity for a specific Command and execution mode.
method.remarks: The supplied CommandDetails instance is associated with this Activity and may be populated with execution-specific cancellation state owned by this Activity. Use a new CommandDetails instance for each execution; reuse is not supported.
method.param: True for asynchronous execution; false for synchronous.
method.returns: An Activity if the Command supports the requested mode; otherwise null.

method.name: SetRecordByToolWithOutput
method.summary: Atomically set the ActivityRecord, preserved exception, and actual output-publication state when the tool is responsible for final disposition.
method.remarks: Returns false for free-mode and command-template-owned activities. A true includes a successfully published null payload.
method.param: True when an output entry was successfully published.
method.returns: True if the record was set.

method.name: TryClaimCommandLifecycle
method.summary: Atomically claims lifecycle ownership for the base Command execution template.
method.returns: True only when this call transitions the Activity from unclaimed to command-template-owned.
method.remarks: A successful claim prevents the Tool from publishing the terminal record for this Activity.

method.name: SetRecordByCommandWithOutput
method.summary: Atomically set the ActivityRecord, preserved exception, and actual output-publication state when the command is responsible for final disposition.
method.remarks: A true includes a successfully published null payload.
method.param: True when an output entry was successfully published.
method.returns: True if the record was set.

method.name: TrySetTaskByCommand
method.summary: Atomically installs the command template's tracked completion task after lifecycle ownership has been claimed.
method.returns: True if the Activity is command-template-owned and the task was installed; otherwise false.

method.name: GetState
method.summary: Compute the current ActivityState for this Activity.

method.name: IsTimedOut
method.summary: Determines whether the current activity has timed out based on its configured timeout and cancellation tokens.
method.returns: if the activity has timed out; otherwise, .

method.name: LogWorkflowEvent
method.exception: Command details are missing required event identity values.

method.name: SetRecordByTool
method.summary: Set the ActivityRecord when the tool is responsible for final disposition.
method.remarks: Returns false for free-mode and command-template-owned activities.
method.returns: True if the record was set.

method.name: SetRecordByToolWithException
method.summary: Atomically set the ActivityRecord and preserved exception when the tool is responsible for final disposition.
method.returns: True if the record was set.

method.name: SetRecordByCommand
method.summary: Set the ActivityRecord when the command is responsible for final disposition.
method.returns: True if the record was set.

method.name: SetRecordByCommandWithException
method.summary: Atomically set the ActivityRecord and preserved exception when the command is responsible for final disposition.
method.returns: True if the record was set.

method.name: StartWorkflowAction
method.summary: Log the start of a workflow action.
method.exception: Command details are missing required event identity values.

method.name: StopWorkflowAction
method.summary: Log the conclusion of a workflow action.
method.exception: Command details are missing required event identity values.

method.name: CancelActivity
method.summary: Request cancellation for this Activity via its CancellationTokenSource.
method.returns: True if cancellation was requested; false if no token or already canceled.
